details: The likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on September 16 has surged to 86.5%, primarily driven by recent U.S. inflation data showing an uptick. This development is expected to exert downward pressure on major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, as higher interest rates typically reduce investor appetite for riskier assets. Wall Street banks have also increased their forecasts for August's core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation, reinforcing expectations for a hawkish stance from the Fed.
title: Fed Rate Hike Odds Jump to 86% Amid Rising Inflation, Pressuring Crypto Markets

details: Senate Republicans have released a revised 630-page CLARITY Act, setting the stage for a critical procedural vote on September 15. The updated legislation specifically targets crypto protocols deemed "decentralized-in-name-only," requiring such entities to register with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). This move signals increased regulatory scrutiny for certain decentralized finance (DeFi) projects, aiming to draw clearer lines between genuinely decentralized platforms and those with centralized control.
title: Senate Republicans Unveil Revised CLARITY Act, Targeting "Decentralized-in-Name-Only" Crypto Protocols
